about: Held-out checkpoints for tools/miss.py --holdout. Protocol: README.md (under the baseline) and .scratchpad/investigations/sim-dist.md. Each 'held' entry: {game: full save id, from_turn: optional (checkpoint pairs whose later save is at or after this turn are held; default the whole game), added: date, scored: {date, units, stars, rules_commit} once scored}. A new save goes into 'held' before any rule is tuned on it and is scored once with --holdout; the score goes into 'scored'. Plain tools/miss.py leaves held checkpoints out, so tuning never sees them. To release one into tuning, move it to 'released' with the date; never move it back.
